sections.sectionSummaryBrief: To have each day be as new in one's eyes requires the revelation of a level above change, which is the encompassing light of Ein Sof, since the limited filling light only sustains creatures according to their bounded capacity.

translations.translation: And this will be understood by prefacing that in order that each day be as new in your eyes, it is through the revelation of a level that is above changes.
And since the definition of the world is
(place and)
time,
time being change,
therefore,
in order that each day be as new in your eyes, it is through the revelation of the Ein Sof that is above enclothing in worlds,
the encompassing light.
For the light that is enclothed in the worlds,
the filling light,
comes in a limited form to give life to the creations according to their worth.
And as our sages, of blessed memory, said,
"Just as the soul fills the body, so the Holy One, blessed be He, fills His world,"
for just as the life of the soul that is enclothed in the body is according to the manner of the body's limbs,
in each limb the life-force is according to its worth,
so too regarding the life-force of the world, into which the filling light is drawn
(this being that the Holy One, blessed be He, fills His world),
the life-force of each creation is according to its worth.
And from this it is understood, all the more so,
regarding the definition of the world in its entirety
(place and time),
that from the perspective of the filling light,
it is impossible for there to be in the world a matter that is above time and place.
And although even the light that is enclothed in the world is not grasped by the definitions of the world,
and as it is written,
"There is none holy like the L-rd," and it is stated in the Zohar,
"How many holy ones there are, yet there is none holy like the L-rd,"
for the novelty in the holiness of the L-rd is that although He is enclothed
in the creations
and gives them life
(in their inwardness),
nevertheless He is holy and separate from them and is not grasped within them.
[And it can be said that this is the explanation of "He is the place of the world, and the world is not His place,"
for "He is the place of the world" refers to the filling light,
which gives life to the world,
and nevertheless "the world is not His place,"
meaning it is not grasped within this],
nevertheless, this that the light remains in its simplicity
(even after it is enclothed in the world)
is regarding the light,
but regarding the world,
the life-force of the world that is enclothed is measured and limited by the definitions of the world.
Therefore,
in order that each day be as new in your eyes
(a matter above time),
it is through the revelation of the encompassing light.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: For the revelation of the encompassing light to be internalized within a person, it must come through the power of Atzmus (Essence), which is beyond both limitation and the unlimited, thereby uniting the encompassing and filling lights.

translations.translation: And now, since the definition of the world is place and time,
it is understood

that this—that through the revelation of the encompassing light, a matter above time and place is drawn into the world—is because the definitions of the world are nullified before the revelation of the light of the boundless, which is above the world.
And this is analogous to will
(for will is a metaphor for the encompassing),
for this that will rules and dominates over the limbs to do contrary to their nature is because they are nullified to the will.
And since the matter of "each day be as new in your eyes" is that one should have vitality in the mitzvos
(as new things),
and vitality is internal,
therefore,
the matter of being above time that shines within the person
(through which they will be as new in your eyes)
must be within him internally.
Therefore,
the empowerment for this—that each day be as new in your eyes—is this: "that which I command you today,"
"I am that I am,"
which is above even the encompassing.
And the explanation is,
that the light of the boundless
(the source of the encompassing light),
is defined by the definition of "boundless,"
and therefore,
this that Ein Sof is without extension and is found in revelation in every place,
even in this physical world,
is because the light is Ein Sof,
but this does not pertain to the world.
And there are two manners in this:
either the light is not felt at all in the world,
or the light is felt in it,
through which a matter above time and place is drawn into it,
but it is in a manner that the definition of the world is nullified before the light.
And in order that the revelation of the light of the boundless in the world be in its inwardness,
it is through the Atzmus
that is not defined by any definition,
neither by the definition of limit nor by the definition of the boundless.
Therefore,
through the revelation of the power of Atzmus,
the union of the boundless and the limited is made,
the unification of the encompassing and the filling,
and the revelation of that which is above time
(drawn from the encompassing)
in the world
(whose life-force is from the filling light)
is in its inwardness.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Furthermore, the unification of encompassing and filling is needed because the concept of "each day as new" itself contains the two opposites of time and above time, requiring that time itself be in a manner above change.

translations.translation: And it should be added,
that this—that the matter of "each day be as new in your eyes" is through the unification of the encompassing and the filling—is not only so that the matter above time
(the encompassing)
be felt within the person inwardly,
but also because in the matter of "each day as new" itself, there are the two opposites of above time and time.
For the matter of "new"
(and the preciousness and endearment in this)
is change,
that at first the thing was not, and it was renewed only now.
And this that each day they are as new in his eyes is that the renewal
(the change)
is in a constant manner that does not change.
Thus, this that the matter of "each day as new" is through the unification of the encompassing and the filling is not only that the revelation of the encompassing
(that is above time)
is felt by him inwardly
(through which he has vitality in the mitzvos as new things),
but moreover,
that time itself
(which from the perspective of the filling light)
is in a manner above time and change
(the revelation of the encompassing).
